name: Mrs. Arch Boyd
role: Wife of hotel man Arch Boyd
bio: Mrs. Arch Boyd was reported ill in December 1884 and September 1885 and helped her husband host a well-attended gathering at the Northern Pacific hotel at the end of 1885. In December 1886 the couple left Medora for Minot.

moments.label: Co-hosted a gathering at the Northern Pacific hotel
Left Medora with her husband for Minot

mentions: Mrs. Arch. Boyd is recovering from an attack of fever.
Mrs. Arch. Boyd has been ill lately, suffering severe pain from her teeth. She is now recovering.

The social hop given by Mr. and Mrs. Arch. Boyd at the Northern Pacific, was thoroughly enjoyed by all of the large number in attendance. Christmas evening could not have been spent in a pleasanter way.
